question: Should OpenClaw remove these shipped root bundled skills now and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin in the same release change?
rationale: This intentionally changes shipped skill availability, existing configuration behavior, official package trust, native artifact distribution, and operator recovery; code review cannot choose those product and release contracts safely.

options.title: Land with migration proof
options.body: Add an automatic migration or equivalent compatibility plan for removed skill references, prove fresh and upgraded installs, authorize the exact dependency graph, and verify Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the coherent Sherpa ClawHub-only package and install routing into a narrower PR while retaining the current bundled-skill set until deprecation is release-owned.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep the current bundled set and close or pause this branch until maintainers approve a deprecation and migration program.

recommendation.title: Land with migration proof
recommendation.body: Add an automatic migration or equivalent compatibility plan for removed skill references, prove fresh and upgraded installs, authorize the exact dependency graph, and verify Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged split work, is assigned here, and has defined the remaining product-decision boundary in the discussion.
